leaves.name: Import P6 PMXML schedule file
acceptance: Uploading a valid PMXML file imports all WBS nodes, activities, relationships, calendars, resources, and assignments via replace_project_schedule with zero data loss for supported fields.
leaves.evidence: importFromPmxml parses WBS, Activity, Relationship, Calendar, Resource, ResourceAssignment elements and calls replace_project_schedule RPC. Migration 20260526115717 confirms the RPC and all target tables with RLS.
gaps: onImport replace flag ignored — replace is always atomic via RPC.

leaves.name: Import XER (Primavera binary export) schedule file
acceptance: XER ingest was originally planned as a co-equal import path alongside PMXML.
leaves.evidence: import-p6.ts:84 states 'XER-specific mappers removed — PMXML is now the sole ingest format.' detectAndImport is a thin wrapper that always calls importFromPmxml. UI dialog title still shows '.xer or .xml' but input only accepts .xml.

leaves.name: Import schedule activities from Gantt chart image via AI
acceptance: Inferred: edge function parse-schedule accepts a Gantt chart image (base64) and returns extracted activities.
leaves.evidence: parse-schedule calls Gemini 2.5 Pro vision to extract WBS rows from a Gantt image. However NO frontend component invokes this function.
gaps: Returned activities not mapped to ImportedSchedule shape.

leaves.name: Compute CPM critical path (calendar-aware, constraint-aware)
acceptance: runCpm computes ES/EF/LS/LF/total-float using the activity's assigned calendar, and marks the continuous critical path.
leaves.evidence: runCpm implements Kahn topo sort, calendar-aware forward/backward passes, 8 constraint types, cycle detection, isCritical marking. Recomputed via useMemo.
gaps: CPM not auto-persisted — persistCpm is manual mutation; tab close leaves is_critical/total_float_days stale.

leaves.name: Editable activity grid (ID, name, start, duration, % complete, float)
acceptance: All analysis functions consume in-memory ScheduleActivity[] directly.
leaves.evidence: Inline editable grid with per-cell Inputs wired to upsertActivity. Critical-path highlight via border-l-destructive.
gaps: Grid does not show early_start/early_finish (CPM dates).

leaves.name: Render Gantt chart with dependency arrows and milestone diamonds
acceptance: GanttChart renders all activities as time-proportional bars; dragging a bar calls onMove and onResize.
leaves.evidence: Time-proportional bars with month headers, drag-to-move/resize. Drag-during-move mutates cpm.byId in-place (line 88) as optimistic preview — onMouseUp persists via onMove correctly.
gaps: Milestone diamonds and dependency arrows referenced but need verification.

leaves.name: Navigate and manage WBS hierarchy tree
acceptance: Uploading a valid PMXML file imports all WBS nodes.
handleAddWbs / handleIndent / handleOutdent allow manual WBS manipulation.
leaves.evidence: WbsTree.tsx renders hierarchical nodes. Indent/outdent wired via parent_wbs_id. WBS imported via importFromPmxml.

leaves.name: Show real-time NJDOT compliance pill bar
acceptance: ComplianceStrip shows correct counts for negative lags, open-ended tasks, CPM cycles, and missing NJDOT M-codes in real time.
leaves.evidence: Computes negativeLags, openEnded, cycles, missing NJDOT M-codes via useMemo. Live; no network call.

leaves.name: Run DCMA 14-point schedule health audit and export .txt
acceptance: DcmaPanel scores all 14 checks against the live in-memory schedule and exports a parseable .txt report.
buildReMemo issues REJECT when any hard-blocker check fails and ACCEPT when all 14 pass.
leaves.evidence: All 14 DCMA checks implemented. buildReMemo generates ACCEPT/REJECT memo with hard-blocker set.
gaps: DCMA check #6 (resources) always returns pass=true — informational only.

leaves.name: Capture, name, and delete schedule baseline snapshots
acceptance: captureBaseline RPC creates a named snapshot; compareProgress computes SPI/CPI and slipping activities.
leaves.evidence: capture_baseline, delete_baseline RPCs and baseline_activities reads all wired. BaselineManager provides UI.
gaps: compareProgress implemented but no UI surface exposes SPI/CPI or slipping activity table — orphaned.

leaves.name: Compare baseline vs forecast and compute SPI/CPI
acceptance: compareProgress computes SPI/CPI and slipping activities.
leaves.evidence: compareProgress implemented but no UI component calls it — unreachable.
gaps: No UI surface — progress analysis unreachable.
chart-export.ts (57 LOC) connection to UI unverified.

leaves.name: Manage project calendars (workweek + exceptions)
acceptance: Calendar-aware CPM uses the activity's assigned calendar.
Calendars are imported via PMXML and editable via CalendarManager.
leaves.evidence: CalendarManager provides workweek/exception editing. parsePmxmlCalendar parses PMXML. CPM resolves per-activity calendars.

leaves.name: Manage resources and activity assignments
acceptance: Uploading PMXML imports resources and assignments.
ResourceManager provides resource + assignment CRUD.
leaves.evidence: ResourceManager 46 LOC only — likely thin list. CRUD mutations fully wired. PMXML imports resources/assignments.
gaps: ActivityInspector may handle per-activity assignment — not separately verified.

leaves.name: Generate TIA fragnet and NJDOT 108-03 narrative
acceptance: buildTia: TIA fragnet + NJDOT 108-03 narrative.
leaves.evidence: buildTia produces ASCII fragnet, narrative, CSV. Only first direct successor traced; rest is boilerplate. No UI surface invokes buildTia.

leaves.name: Link schedule activities to pay items
acceptance: activity_pay_items table referenced in migration; p6_activity_id column on pay_items.
leaves.evidence: DB schema has activity_pay_items and p6_activity_id but no frontend references these tables. Stream doc silent.
gaps: No UI to link activities to pay items.
No hook or mutation reads/writes activity_pay_items.
Stream doc silent despite DB existing.

leaves.name: Track NJDOT required milestone activities (M100–M950)
acceptance: ComplianceStrip shows correct counts for missing NJDOT M-codes in real time.
leaves.evidence: All 9 required NJDOT milestones defined; detects via prefix match. Manual addition of milestone-typed activities supported.
gaps: Milestone detection uses startsWith — M code must be first token; no normalization beyond .toUpperCase().

leaves.name: AACE cost estimate class reference
acceptance: AACE_CLASSES reference data for schedule classification.
leaves.evidence: aace.ts exports AACE_CLASSES. No UI/analysis pipeline consumes it.
gaps: No AACE classification integrated into DCMA panel or compliance strip.

leaves.name: Export RE feedback memo as PDF or DOCX
acceptance: downloadMemoPdf / downloadMemoDoc — memo export.
leaves.evidence: memo-export.ts defines exports. DcmaPanel exports .txt (dcmaSummary), not PDF/DOCX — memo-export.ts may be unused.
gaps: DcmaPanel exports .txt not PDF/DOCX; memo-export.ts wiring unverified.

docDrift.claim: ImportP6Panel dialog title reads 'Import P6 schedule (.xer or .xml)' implying XER support.
docDrift.actual: XER parsers were removed (import-p6.ts:84); only PMXML accepted. File input accept is .xml only.

docDrift.claim: Stream doc Surfaces lists src/lib/p6xml/parser.ts but no parse-schedule edge function.
docDrift.actual: supabase/functions/parse-schedule/index.ts is a live edge function that parses Gantt images via Gemini vision — absent from stream doc.

docDrift.claim: Current state item 3: Drag-move writes optimistically to cpm.byId in-place rather than through onMove/upsertActivity.
docDrift.actual: onMouseUp does call onMove correctly on drag completion. Doc overstates severity.

docDrift.claim: compareProgress / chartRows are listed as implemented.
docDrift.actual: Implemented in progress.ts but called by no UI component — effectively missing from user perspective.

docDrift.claim: Stream doc does not mention schedule-to-pay-item linking.
docDrift.actual: DB schema includes activity_pay_items with no frontend implementation.

proposedDocPatch.addBullet: **XER support removed** — import-p6.ts:84 confirms PMXML is sole ingest format. ImportP6Panel dialog title still references .xer — update UI copy.
**parse-schedule edge function** — supabase/functions/parse-schedule/index.ts exists and calls Gemini 2.5 Pro to extract Gantt rows. No frontend invokes it; document as unwired.
**compareProgress / chartRows not surfaced** — progress.ts functions implemented but no UI calls them; SPI/CPI view missing from ScheduleWorkspace.
**AACE_CLASSES orphaned** — analysis/aace.ts exports classification data but is imported nowhere.
**activity_pay_items table exists with no frontend** — DB schema and RLS deployed but no hook reads/writes.
- supabase/functions/parse-schedule/index.ts — AI-powered Gantt image → activity extraction (Gemini 2.5 Pro vision; unwired)
